senses.gloss: लम्भ लम्भ, लम्भन, &c. See col. 1.

लम्भक, अस्, m. one who obtains, an obtainer,
one who finds, a finder.

लम्भन, अम्, n. the act of obtaining or re-
ceiving, attainment, recovery; the act of procuring,
causing to get; abuse, reviling (?).

लम्भनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be obtained or re-
ceived, to be attained, attainable.

लम्भम्, ind. having taken or obtained, (लम्-
भं लम्भम् repeatedly taking, &c.)

लम्भयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to obtain,
procuring, producing.

लम्भित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), caused to
obtain or receive, given, procured, gained; height-
ened, improved; cherished; applied, employed,
adapted; addressed, spoken to; abused (?).
—लम्-
भित-कान्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, one who has acquired lustre
or beauty.

लम्भुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who is accus-
tomed to receive.

लम् लम् (a later form of rt. रम्), cl.
1. P. लमति (= रमति), ललाम (=
रराम), &c., to delight in, sport, enjoy (sexually).

लमक, अस्, m. = रमक, a lover, wooer, para-
mour, (according to Ujjvala-datta, Uṇādi-s. II. 33,
= तीर्थ-शोधक); a proper N.

लम्न लम्न, आस्, m. pl., N. of a particular
tribe.

लम्पक लम्पक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a Jaina
sect.

लम्पाक, अस्, आ, अम्, = लम्पट; (अस्), m., N.
of a country (= मुरण्ड; according to some the
district of Lamghan in Cabul).

लम्पट लम्पट, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps con-
nected with rt. लप्; cf. लिम्पट), covetous, greedy,
desirous, lustful; hankering after, addicted to (licen-
tious pleasures), lascivious, dissolute; (अस्), m. a
libertine, lecher, dissolute person.
—लम्पट-ता, f.
or लम्पट-त्व, अम्, n. eagerness, greediness; liber-
tinism, lasciviousness, dissoluteness, lewdness.

लम्पा लम्पा, f., N. of a town; of a king-
dom.
—लम्पा-पटह, अस्, m. a kind of drum (=
प्रतिपत्ति-पटह, टट्टरी).

लम्फ लम्फ, अस्, m. a leap, spring, jump;
[cf. झम्प.]

लम्फन, अम्, n. leaping, springing, jumping,
(a form उल्-लम्फन, ‘jumping up,’ is given.)

लम्ब् लम्ब् (a later form of rt. रम्ब्), cl.
1. A. लम्बते (sometimes also P. लम्-
बति), ललम्बे, लम्बिष्यते, अलम्बिष्ट, लम्-
बितुम्, to hang down, depend, dangle, hang from,
hang on or upon, depend on or from; to sink, sink
down, go down, decline, fall, set (as the sun); to be
fastened to, be attached to, hold on to, rest on; to
fall behind, stay behind, lag behind, be retarded; to
delay, tarry; to sound (fr. rt. रम्ब्; cf. rt. लम्भ्):
Caus. लम्बयति, &c., to cause to hang down or
depend, let down; to hang up, suspend; to cause to
be fastened or attached, join; to stretch out, extend;
to depress, (perhaps) discourage; [cf. Lat. labi;
Lith. rambus; Angl. Sax. limpian, ge-limp; Eng.
limp.]

लम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging down, depending,
pendulous, pendent, dangling; hanging on or upon,
attached to; long, tall; expanded, great, large;
spacious, capacious; (अस्), m. a perpendicular (in
geometry); complement of latitude, co-latitude (in
astronomy), the arc between the pole of any place
and the zenith; epithet of a particular throw or
move (at a kind of chess or a game like backgam-
mon or draughts); N. of a Muni; of a Daitya; a
present, bribe (?) , = नर्तक, अङ्ग, कान्त; (आ),
f. a kind of bitter gourd or cucumber; N. of one of
the Mātṛs attending upon Skanda; N. of Durgā or
Gaurī; of Lakṣmī; of a daughter of Dakṣa and
wife of Dharma or Manu; of a Rākṣasī.
—लम्ब-
कर्ण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having pendulous ears, long-
eared; (अस्), m. a he-goat, goat; an elephant; a
hawk, falcon; a Rākṣasa; Alangium Hexapetalum;
N. of one of Śiva's attendants; of an ass (in one of
the stories of the Pañca-tantra); of a hare (in the
Pañca-tantra).
—लम्ब-केश, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, hav-
ing hanging or flowing hair.
—लम्ब-केशक, अस्,
m. ‘long-haired,’ N. of a Muni.
—लम्ब-गुण,
अस्, m. the sine of the co-latitude (in astronomy).
—लम्ब-जठर, अस्, आ, अम्, big-bellied.
—लम्-
ब-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, letting the tongue hang out;
(अस्), m., N. of a Rākṣasa.
—लम्ब-ज्या or लम्ब-
ज्यका, f. the sine of the co-latitude (in astronomy).
—लम्ब-दन्ता, f. a kind of plant (= सैंहली).
—लम्ब-पयोधरा, f. a woman with large or
pendent breasts; N. of one of the Mātṛs attending
upon Skanda.
—लम्ब-रेखा, f. the complement
of latitude, co-latitude (in astronomy).
—लम्ब-
वीजा, f. = लम्ब-दन्ता.
—लम्ब-स्फिच्, क्, क्, क्,
having large or protuberant buttocks.
—लम्बाक्ष
(˚ब-अक्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Muni.
—लम्बालक
(˚ब-अल्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having pendulous curls or
ringlets.
—लम्बालक-त्व, अम्, n. pendulosity of
ringlets.
—लम्बोदर (˚ब-उद्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having
a large or protuberant belly, pot-bellied; (अस्), m. a
voracious person, glutton; N. of Gaṇeśa; of a king;
of a Muni; (ई), f., N. of a female demon.
—लम्-
बोष्ठ (˚ब-ओष्˚), अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having a large
[]
or prominent under-lip; (अस्), m. a camel, (also
written लम्बौष्ठ.)

लम्बक, अस्, m. a perpendicular (in geometry);
the complement of latitude, co-latitude (in astro-
nomy); N. of a particular implement or vessel; N.
of the fifteenth astronomical Yoga; N. of the larger
sections or books of the Kathā-sarit-sāgara (of which
there are eighteen, containing in all 124 Taraṅgas
or chapters); (इका), f. the uvula or soft palate.
—लम्बिका-कोकिला, f., N. of a deity.

लम्बन, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging down, depending,
pendulous; causing to hang down; (अस्), m., N. of
Śiva; phlegm, the phlegmatic humor; (अम्), n.
hanging down, depending, descending, falling; fringe;
a long necklace (depending from the neck to the
navel); the parallax in longitude (of the moon), the
interval of the lines between the earth's centre and
surface; epithet of a particular mode of fighting;
N. of a Varṣa in Kuśa-dvīpa.
—लम्बन-विधि,
इस्, m. the rule for calculating the above parallax (in
astronomy).
लम्बिका, f. See under लम्बक above.

लम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging down, pendent;
suspended; sunk, gone down, set; laying hold of,
attached to, supported or resting on; = वि-लम्बित,
slow (of time in music).

लम्बुक, अस्, m., N. of a serpent-demon; N. of
the fifteenth astronomical Yoga, (for लम्बक.)
लम्बुषा, f. a necklace of seven strings.

लम्भ् लम्भ् (= rt. रम्भ्), cl. 1. A.
लम्भते, &c., to sound.

लामकायन लामकायन, अस्, m. (fr. लमक),
a patronymic; N. of a preceptor; (आस्), m. pl. the
descendants of Lamaka.
लामकायनि, इस्, m. a patronymic.

लामकायनिन्, इनस्, m. pl. the school of Lāma-
kāyana.
लामगायनि, इस्, m. = लामकायनि.

लामज्जक लामज्जक, अम्, n. the root of the
fragrant grass Andropogon Muricatus.

लाम्पट्य लाम्पट्य, अम्, n. (fr. लम्पट),
lasciviousness, lustfulness, lewdness, dissoluteness.
